description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Finance team 

The Finance team ensures Affirm remains financially sound and strategically positioned for growth. Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role

We are looking for a self-motivated, hardworking, and analytically minded professional to join the Strategic Finance team during a pivotal moment of growth! As Affirm Bank is currently in its formation phase, we are actively building out our foundational team. Reporting to the Bank Head of Strategic Finance, the Bank Strategic Finance Lead will play a key role in the formation and operational build-out of the Bank. You will develop and monitor Bank financial and KPI forecasts, drive strategy, and perform financial analyses throughout the Bank. Your work will help set Bank-level goals, annual budgets, capital stress testing and monitoring, and stakeholder guidance, while building the infrastructure to hold the Bank accountable to achieving its goals. You will have a unique opportunity to work cross-functionally and use quantitative insights to drive better decision-making across the organization. The ideal candidate will not only have superb technical skills but also strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally and present to all levels of the Bank organization.

What you’ll do

  • Develop the end-to-end forecasting and budget process, and design, build, and maintain complex financial models to support strategic planning, scenario analysis, and decision-making
  • Drive business outcomes and performance management by developing automated financial analytics dashboards and reporting infrastructure
  • Analyze, diagnose variances, and report realized financial performance to Bank Executives, the Bank CFO, and other company leaders
  • Develop capital stress testing, ongoing monitoring, and help establish performance measurements and targets while ensuring analytic rigor in decision-making
  • Partner closely with Affirm, Inc. cross-functional teams to integrate financial workflows and join a tight-knit team with outsized impact

What we look for

  • Passion and drive to build robust financial models
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in analytical roles (e.g., strategic finance, consulting, data science, or analytics)
  • Strong working knowledge of financial modeling tools
  • Excellent proficiency in predictive analytics and forecasting
  • Familiarity with fintech, lending, and payments business models preferred
  • Proven ability to operate with ownership and influence in a fast-paced, dynamic, and ambiguous work environment with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

Base Pay Grade - K

Equity Grade - USA 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $145,000 - $205,000

USA base pay range (All other US states) per year: $128,000 - $188,000

Location - Remote U.S.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.
